when: you have no completed item yet and your CS is level with or above their jungler's
asks: how long do I just farm
should I keep farming or gank
when do I stop full clearing
am I supposed to be farming right now
is it okay to just power farm
say: Full clear until your first item is done, ganking only the lane beside your next camp, or break off if a lane offers a free kill.
more: A farming jungler is paid by camps, so a gank is only cheap when it sits on the way to the next one.
The first finished item is the checkpoint. After it you can win the river fights you would have lost before, so that is when you start spending time on the map.
The cost is that their jungler may get a kill somewhere while you clear. You accept that as long as your lanes are not being dived.
check: Which of your camps are up, and whether the lane next to them has an enemy pushed up without an escape.
breaks: If two of your lanes are already dying, farming alone will not be enough. Cover the lane that can still carry, then go back to camps.
basis: pro:Gank when your camps are down

when: your CS is well below their jungler's and you have no kills or assists
asks: I'm behind in farm what do I do
their jungler is way ahead of me
how do I catch up in the jungle
I'm down a level on their jungler
I got invaded and now I'm behind
say: Farm the half where your lanes can move and give up the other, or hover your strongest lane and gank from there if both are unsafe.
more: Being behind makes your route easy to guess. The camp closest to their strong lane is the one they expect you at.
Giving one half costs camps but keeps you alive, and each camp you finish safely closes the level gap.
You catch up through his mistakes more than your plays. If he dies or shows far away, that is your turn to take his side.
check: Which of your lanes is pushed in, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their jungler just died or showed on the far side, do not hide. Take the camps and the crab he cannot reach.
basis: pro:The jungle beside a losing lane is theirs

when: you have more completed items and a higher level than their jungler
asks: I'm fed from farming, now what
when do I stop farming and fight

do I keep clearing or group

say: You've farmed enough, so take your lead to the next objective and fight for it, or invade his camps if nothing spawns for a while.
more: A lead only counts when it is used. Every clear you add now gives their carries time to finish items too.
The objective is the best place to spend it because their jungler has to walk into you there.
Invading keeps him behind between spawns, but it only works while your nearest lane can follow you in.
check: How long until the next dragon or Baron, and whether your lanes near it are pushed.
breaks: If your gold is still unspent, recall first. Old items make the lead much smaller than the scoreboard says.
basis: pro:A lead is not power until it is spent

say: Keep farming toward your item and hover the one lane that can still fight, or drop a camp to stop a dive you can reach.
more: You cannot save three lanes. Pick the one whose laner still has levels and a wave near his tower, and let the others play safe.
Your items are the team's way back, so trading your whole clear for failed ganks leaves nobody strong.
Stopping a dive is the exception. It costs one camp and denies them a kill and tower plates.
check: Which ally still has close to even CS and level, and whether the enemy is stacking a wave to dive.
breaks: If the enemy already has two dragons, the next one leaves them a single dragon from soul. Show at that one with your team instead of farming through it.

asks: what's my plan as Bel'Veth
how do I scale on Bel'Veth

say: Stack your passive on every large monster and takedown, since forty stacks buys a ninety second True Form, or skirmish early if a lane is winning.
more: Death in Lavender gives permanent attack speed for large monsters, large minions and champion takedowns, so full clears are also stacks.
At forty stacks True Form lasts ninety seconds, and at eighty it is permanent. That is the long plan the whole clear is building toward.
Fighting early is fine when the kill is likely, because a champion takedown stacks too. A lost skirmish costs both camps and stacks.
check: Your current stack count on the passive, which the coach cannot see.
breaks: If their jungler lives in your jungle, you will not out-stack him by clearing. Stay near a lane that can help and take the camps he is not on.

Highlander makes you immune to slows but not to stuns and roots. A gank into a held stun usually ends with you dead.
Arriving second to a fight that already started is your best early play, because their crowd control is spent.
check: Whether the lane's crowd control was just used, and how many enemies could arrive.
breaks: If the enemy team has almost no hard crowd control, you can fight much earlier than this.

A mark in their jungle is a fight their jungler knows about. It is decided by which lane arrives first, not by the duel.
Marking a champion you can actually kill with a laner is the safer way to stack early.
check: Where your current mark is, and whether the lane next to it has push.
breaks: If you are behind their jungler in level, stop walking into his camps for marks. Farm and take champion marks from ganks instead.

They can call the bluff. If your objective is slow and theirs is nearly done, they simply finish first.
Be ready to drop it and fight on the move when they do come.
check: Whether they have a ward on your objective, and which team kills its monster faster.
breaks: If their dragon is soul or Elder, do not trade for it. Go there instead.
basis: pro:A second objective moves the fight

when: one or more of your carries are dead and an objective is up
asks: my adc is dead do we still go
can we baron without our carry
our mid just died do we contest
should we wait for him to respawn
carry is dead what's the call
say: Wait for the respawn and defend with wave clear, or take a safe trade far from them, because you can't fight without your damage.
more: A fight without your main damage dealer lasts until your tanks fall over.
Their choice is the objective or a tower. Holding both is not available, so give the cheaper one.
Use the time to recall and buy so the next fight is at full items.
check: His respawn timer, and what the enemy can finish before it ends.
breaks: If their jungler is also dead, the objective is still possible. Check that you have the damage to kill it before they return.
basis: pro:Count who can actually arrive before contesting

when: an outer or inner tower near the next objective is still standing for the enemy
asks: should we take a tower before dragon
what do we do before baron spawns
tower or objective
how do I set up the next objective
do we siege mid first
say: Take the tower nearest the next objective first to open the approach, or go straight to the pit if it spawns within a minute.
more: Towers hold the paths into the river. With theirs gone, they reach the pit only by walking through dark jungle.
It also moves your waves forward, which keeps their wave clearers at home.
The order matters. A tower taken two minutes early is setup, one taken at the spawn is a trade.
check: Which tower is closest to the next spawn, and how much time is left.
breaks: If sieging it means standing under tower shots against good wave clear, set vision instead and wait for the objective.

when: their jungler has a completed item and you have none
asks: he got his item before me
their jungler is an item up on me
can I fight him without my item
he finished first item what do I do
I'm behind on items in the jungle
say: Stay off him until your item is done and farm the side he isn't on, or fight only where a laner gets there first.
more: A finished item against components is the biggest gap of the early game. A duel now is his to take.
He has to use it quickly, so expect him at the next objective or in your camps beside a losing lane.
One clear usually closes it. Camps on the far side from him are the safe way there.
check: How far you are from finishing your item, and which of your lanes could reach a fight first.
breaks: If he is dead or just showed on the far side, the gap doesn't matter for that moment. Take the objective or his camps while he is away.
basis: pro:Do not fight an objective one spike behind

when: their jungler has more completed items than you
asks: their jungler is an item ahead of me
he out-items me what do I do at dragon
I can't duel their jungler anymore
he's stronger than me how do I play objectives
say: He wins the duel right now, so stay with your team at objectives and let them zone him, or trade for the other side.
more: An item down, you lose both the one on one and the walk to the pit. With four teammates around you, neither happens.
Your job shrinks to arriving alive and pressing Smite. That is still worth a full player.
If your team can't arrive first, taking something on the far side at the same moment beats a late contest.
check: Where he was last seen, and whether your team can get to the pit before his.
breaks: If your laners are the ones ahead, don't hide. Start the objective with them and make him walk into three people.
basis: pro:Do not fight an objective one spike behind

when: you are two or more levels below their jungler
asks: I'm two levels down on their jungler
he's way higher level than me
how do I play when he outlevels me
I'm so far behind their jungler
say: Don't meet him alone, so farm your safe camps and empty side waves to close the gap, or follow your team's engage at objectives.
more: He knows where a jungler this far behind has to farm. The camp nearest his strong lane is the one he checks first.
Side waves nobody is on give gold and levels without going through him.
At objectives you are a Smite and some crowd control. Arrive with the team, not ahead of it.
check: Which of your camps are alive away from where he last showed, and which side wave has no ally on it.
breaks: If he dies, use that respawn timer on his camps or the objective. It is your cheapest way back.
basis: pro:A jungler who is behind has few places to go

when: your level and completed items are about equal to their jungler's
asks: we're even do I farm or fight
I'm not ahead or behind what now
even game what's my plan
do I keep farming at even items
mid game and it's even what do I do
say: Keep clearing between objectives and be at every spawn early, or skip a fight that starts while your team is a player short.
more: On a scaling champion an even game is going your way. Each clear moves the item count toward you.
What you can't do is give objectives for free. Farm on the side of the next spawn so the clear ends there.
The losing version is a coin flip fight in the river with no objective behind it. You do not need it.
check: Which objective is next, and how many of your team are alive and nearby.
breaks: If they are stacking dragons while you clear, even is an illusion. Contest the one that would be their third.

when: after 14:00, you have fewer completed items than their jungler and the enemy team has more dragons
asks: I'm still weak can I keep farming
when do I have to stop farming
I'm behind and they keep taking objectives
do I group even though I'm not strong yet
say: Farm only the camps beside your team and be the Smite at every objective, or take their far camps while they're grouped elsewhere.
more: The solo farming plan ended when they started banking dragons. From here every objective you miss costs more than a clear gives.
Camps next to your team still pay, and you are in place when something starts.
When all five of them show on one side, their camps on the other are gold with no fight attached.
check: How many dragons they have, and how many enemies are showing on the map.
breaks: If your team cannot win the fight yet, give a dragon that is not for soul and take a tower at the same moment instead.
basis: pro:Give early dragons, then fight the one before soul point

when: after 14:00 and you have the most completed items on your team
asks: can I farm a side lane as the carry
do I take waves or group
should I be split farming
am I allowed to take the side wave
do I leave my team to farm
say: Take the side wave nearest the next objective and be back well before it spawns, or stay grouped if your team can't hold without you.
more: Waves are a lot of gold at this stage, and you are the one who should be holding it.
A wave on the objective's side keeps you one short walk from the fight. The far side wave is how carries get caught.
While you are away your team has no Smite. They should give ground, not start anything.
check: Where the next objective is, how long until it spawns, and how many enemies are missing.
breaks: If a laner on your team needs that wave to finish an item, leave it. Two half-finished carries are worse than one finished one.

when: after 14:00
asks: I'm a tank do I take side waves
should I farm or stay with my team
do I need gold on a tank mid game
can I catch that wave
say: Leave side waves to your carries and stay with the group, or take one only when it's crashing into your tower with nobody near.
more: Your engage is why your team can stand in the river. When you leave, they have to back off.
Gold does more on a carry than on you. Your camps and assists are enough.
A wave dying to your tower is the exception. Nobody gets it otherwise, and killing it protects the tower.
check: Whether a carry is already walking to that wave, and where the enemy team is.
breaks: If you are two levels down, you do need it. Take camps and that wave quickly, then rejoin before the next spawn.

when: after 25:00
asks: I fall off late what do I do
my champ is useless late
how do I play late on an early game jungler
we didn't end early now what
say: Play for picks and Smite, catching whoever walks alone before an objective, or stand with your carry and peel if nobody separates.
more: Your damage no longer wins a five on five, but a carry caught alone still dies.
A numbers lead at the spawn is how an early champion wins a late objective.
If they move as five, your value is vision, Smite and whatever crowd control you have.
check: Who is showing alone in a side lane, and how long until the next objective.
breaks: If you are still well ahead in items, you have not fallen off yet. Force the objective now, before their items arrive.

when: you have fewer completed items than their jungler and more deaths than kills
asks: I'm a tank but I die instantly
I'm behind do I still engage
I can't go in without dying
how do I fight as a behind tank
say: Stop going in first and stand in front of your carry with your stun held, or engage only on someone caught away from their team.
more: A tank who is behind dies before his team arrives, and then the fight is four against five.
Held crowd control still works at any item count. Their diver has to get through it.
A pick on one isolated player is the engage you can still afford.
check: Where their diver is, and whether the target you want is really alone.
breaks: If your team has no other way to start and an objective is being lost, go in with everyone already next to you. Half an engage is worse than none.

when: you have fewer completed items than their carries
asks: I'm a carry jungler and behind how do I fight
I don't do damage yet
do I still fight when I'm weak
what's my job in fights when I'm behind
say: Hit whoever is nearest from behind your front line and save Smite for the objective, or skip a fight with nothing at stake.
more: Without the item lead you can't choose targets. The tank in front of you is still damage that counts.
Smite is the part of you that doesn't need items. Stay close enough to the pit to use it.
Fights over nothing only delay your items. Camps and waves are the better trade then.
check: What the fight is actually for, and where their assassin or diver is.
breaks: If the fight is for soul or Elder, you can't skip it. Stay at the back and live as long as possible.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Viego teamfight
when do I go in as Viego
who do I ult on Viego
how do I get going in fights on Viego
say: Stay at the edge until someone is low, then finish him with Heartbreaker, or stun their diver with Spectral Maw if nobody is low.
more: Heartbreaker is an execute, so it is worth far more on a low target than as an opener. It also knocks his allies away.
Enemies who fall leave a wraith for you. The first kill is the hard one, and the fight gets easier from there.
Harrowed Path gives camouflage and speed in the mist, which is how you wait near a fight without being targeted.
check: Enemy health bars as the fight goes on, and which stuns are still unused.
breaks: If you are the only front line your team has, waiting leaves your carries alone. Stand with them and fight whoever comes.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Hecarim teamfight
where do I ult as Hecarim
do I go on their backline as Hecarim
how do I engage on Hecarim
say: Charge their backline from the side with Onslaught of Shadows so the fear scatters them, or run down whoever is on your carry.
more: The fear comes at the end of the charge, so aim to finish on their carries, not pass through them.
Spirit of Dread heals you from damage nearby enemies take, your team's included. Stand in the middle of them when you use it.
Warpath turns bonus movement speed into attack damage, so Devastating Charge is damage as well as travel.
check: Whether your team is close enough to hit the people you scatter.
breaks: If you fear them away from your team, nobody can follow. Come from behind so they run toward your side.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Wukong teamfight
when do I use Cyclone
how do I engage on Wukong
do I flank as Wukong
say: Go invisible with Warrior Trickster and Cyclone as many as you can once your team is in range, or hold Cyclone for their divers.
more: Cyclone knocks up everyone it strikes. It is a team engage, so it needs your damage dealers already close.
Warrior Trickster hides the approach and leaves a clone behind, which often draws their first abilities.
Nimbus Strike is the gap closer. Use it on someone standing next to the people you want to knock up.
check: How many enemies are grouped, and how far behind you your team is.
breaks: If they are spread out, don't wait for five. Knock up their main carry and let your team kill him.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Maokai teamfight
where do I throw Maokai ult
do I engage or peel on Maokai
what do I do in fights as Maokai
say: Send Nature's Grasp down the path they must walk to start the fight, or keep Twisted Advance and Bramble Smash to peel your carry.
more: Nature's Grasp advances slowly and roots whoever it reaches, so it works best in narrow paths where they cannot step around it.
Twisted Advance makes you untargetable on the way in and roots the target. It is a reliable stop on one diver.
Saplings are more effective in brush. Throw them into the brush around the pit before the fight.
check: Which way they have to approach, and who is threatening your carry.
breaks: If they are in open ground, the wall gets sidestepped. Hold it until they are in a choke or already locked down.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Skarner teamfight
who do I Impale
do I drag their carry
how do I engage as Skarner
say: Impale whoever you can reach and drag them back into your team, or hold it to suppress the diver on your carry.
more: Impale suppresses and you drag the victims along as you move, so one catch near your team is usually a kill.
Ixtal's Impact goes through terrain and slams a champion into the next wall for a stun. It is your way in from an unexpected side.
A suppressed front liner still counts. Removing anyone starts the fight a player up.
check: Where your team is standing, so you know which way to drag.
breaks: If going through the wall puts you behind five people with no team near, you die holding one of them. Wait at the front instead.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Warwick teamfight
who do I ult as Warwick
when do I go in on Warwick
do I jump their carry
say: Let the fight start, then Infinite Duress a carry and howl in the middle of them, or suppress whoever dives your backline.
more: Infinite Duress stops on the first champion you hit, so a tank can step in front. Pick an angle with nobody between.
Primal Howl reduces the damage you take and then makes nearby enemies flee. Use it once you are in the middle.
Blood Hunt speeds you toward low enemies. Late in a fight you are the one who runs them down.
check: Who is standing between you and the target, and whether your team can follow.
breaks: If you would land alone among five, the suppression ends and you die. Use it as peel and fight front to back.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Nunu teamfight
where do I use Absolute Zero
do I snowball in
what do I do in fights as Nunu
say: Roll a snowball in from the side for the knock up, then channel Absolute Zero on them, or hold Consume and Smite for the objective.
more: The snowball grows in size and speed as it rolls, so start it far away and out of sight.
Absolute Zero slows and deals its big damage at the end. It lands when your team's crowd control holds them inside.
Around a pit, your secure may matter more than your damage. Standing on the objective is a fair choice.
check: Whether they can simply walk out of the blizzard, and how low the objective is.
breaks: If they have an interrupt ready, the channel is wasted. Use the ultimate only as a zone to keep them off your carry.

asks: Graves teamfight
who do I shoot as Graves
do I go for their carry on Graves
where do I stand as Graves
say: Shoot whoever is closest and keep using Quickdraw for the resistances, or burst a carry with Collateral Damage if he steps forward.
more: Your bullets do not pass through units, so tanks and minions block shots meant for someone behind them.
Dashing toward an enemy champion with Quickdraw gives more True Grit. That is what lets you stand close.
Smoke Screen cuts sight range. Dropped on their carries, it stops them shooting at your team for a moment.
check: What is standing between you and the target you want.
breaks: If their front line is too tough to shoot through, go round the side before the fight so the carries are the nearest target.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Shyvana teamfight
when do I ult as Shyvana
do I dive as Shyvana
how do I fight in dragon form
say: Leap in with Dragon's Descent when they're clumped and fight in the middle, or stay in front of your carry if you're behind.
more: Dragon's Descent makes enemies along your path flee and empowers your abilities, so where you leap decides the fight.
In Dragon Form, Molten Burst leaves a trail of fire and Inferno Aegis heals when its explosion hits a champion.
Scalemail stacks from your clears are why you can stay in there. A Shyvana who skipped farm cannot.
check: Whether Dragon's Descent is available, and how grouped they are.
breaks: If you scatter them away from your team's damage, you have helped them. Leap from the side or behind so they run toward your team.

asks: Bel'Veth teamfight
when do I go in as Bel'Veth
how do I fight on Bel'Veth
who do I hit as Bel'Veth
say: Come in second after their stuns are used and channel Royal Maelstrom among them, or wait outside if True Form isn't available.
more: Royal Maelstrom gives damage reduction and lifesteal but roots you in place. It is strong once their crowd control is spent and deadly before.
Above and Below knocks up and slows. Use it to hold a carry, or to stop the diver on your own.
Every takedown adds permanent attack speed, so cleaning up a won fight also builds the next one.
check: Which enemy stuns have been used, and whether your True Form can be turned on.
breaks: If your team has no front line, nobody absorbs the first abilities for you. Fight at a choke or pick off one player first.

asks: Kha'Zix teamfight
how do I fight grouped teams as Kha
when do I go in on Kha'Zix
who do I jump as Kha'Zix
say: Wait for someone to stand apart from the group, since isolation is your damage, or poke with Void Spike until one does.
more: Taste Their Fear deals more to isolated targets. Against a tight group you are a much weaker champion.
Void Assault makes you invisible. Use it to drop their focus mid-fight and come back on a low target.
Fights that spread out, like chases through the jungle, are the ones you win.
check: Who is standing away from their teammates, and whether you were seen on the way.
breaks: If they never separate, don't force it. Stay beside your carry and kill whoever dives him, since a diver is usually alone.

when: you are level 6 or above
asks: Evelynn teamfight
when do I go in as Eve
who do I charm
how do I teamfight on Evelynn
say: Put Allure on a carry from camouflage before the fight and finish with Last Caress, or wait and clean up whoever gets low.
more: Allure needs its delay to run before it charms, so start it while they are still posturing, not once the fight is on.
Last Caress makes you untargetable for a moment and moves you backwards a long way. It is the kill and the exit together.
Being unseen near a fight is pressure on its own. Their carries play further back when they don't know where you are.
check: Whether a control ward or a sweeper has revealed you, which the coach cannot see.
breaks: If the carry is guarded and you would be stunned on the way in, take the support or stay out until the fight thins.

when: a major objective is contested and both junglers are alive
asks: how do I win the smite
when do I press smite
I keep missing smite
fifty fifty at baron what do I do
do I just smite as soon as I can
say: Stand in the pit and hold Smite for the last hit, or have your team push their jungler out so there's no contest.
more: Watch the objective's health, not the fight. Most missed Smites happen when the jungler turns to hit a champion.
Your team's burst changes the timing. Ask them to hold big abilities so the health drops steadily near the end.
The duel is avoidable. A jungler who is knocked away or zoned at the last moment cannot press anything.
check: The objective's health, whether Smite is ready, and where their jungler is standing.
breaks: If you are being hit and about to die in the pit, back out. A dead jungler loses it for certain, a live one can still fight for it.
basis: pro:If you cannot win the Smite duel, remove their jungler

when: you and their jungler are both dead and Baron or a dragon is up
asks: we both died who gets baron
both junglers are dead
I traded with their jungler now what
who respawns first
say: If you respawn before their jungler, go straight to it with your team, or have them hold waves if he's back first.
more: Late on, the first jungler back owns the objective. The other team has no reliable last hit until theirs arrives.
Tell your team now which it is, so they are either walking there or clearing waves, not standing between.
If the timers are close, the fight starts as you both arrive. Come with your team, not ahead of it.
check: Both respawn timers, and how long each of you needs to walk there.
breaks: If your team is too low to start it even with you, use your head start on a tower or their camps instead.
basis: pro:A dead jungler makes the objective free

when: your health is low and an objective spawns within a minute
asks: I'm low do I back before dragon
should I recall I'm half health
can I stay with this health
do I base before baron
I'm low but it's spawning
say: Recall now and walk back with your team, since a low jungler can't hold the pit, or stay only if they're already fighting.
more: They aim for the jungler first at an objective. At low health you are removed before Smite matters.
An early recall costs seconds. A late one, or a death, costs the objective.
If gold is waiting too, the same recall brings an item to the fight.
check: Exactly how long until the spawn, and whether it is safe to recall where you are.
breaks: If the objective is already low and their jungler is not there, finish it first and recall after.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: one of your inhibitors is down and an objective is up
asks: our inhib is down do we still go baron
super minions are pushing what do I do
do I defend base or go to dragon
inhibitor's down where do I go
say: Clear that lane's wave first, then go to the objective together, or leave one wave clearer home if it's Elder or soul.
more: Super minions take towers by themselves. Leaving as five with that wave alive can lose the base while you fight.
Clearing it first buys the time for one objective fight. Go straight after, because the next wave is coming.
For a game-deciding objective you need four there. The one at home should be whoever clears fastest.
check: Where the super minion wave is, and how long until the objective spawns.
breaks: If you cannot both hold the base and contest, hold the base. A lost Baron can be defended, a lost nexus tower cannot.

when: three or more allies are dead and you are alive
asks: my team just died what do I do
everyone's dead
do I defend alone
they aced us and I'm alive
should I try to steal alone
say: Don't fight alone, so clear waves from under a tower to stall, or try the steal only if it's Baron or Elder.
more: Your death adds time to their push. Alive, you can kill minions and make the towers do the work.
Clear from range if you can. Walking up to the wave is how the last defender dies.
A steal is a long shot, but your life is worth less than a game-ending buff. That is the only case to risk it.
check: Your allies' respawn timers, and whether the enemy went to an objective or to your base.
breaks: If they are diving the base with a full wave, fall back to a tower you can actually defend. Giving an outer structure is fine.

when: the enemy team has just killed Elder
asks: they got elder what do we do
how do we play against elder
can we fight them with elder
they have elder buff
say: Don't fight them while Elder is on, so clear waves from range and give outer towers, or fight only if they dive your base.
more: Elder decides fights. The answer is to avoid one until it runs out.
Structures can be traded for time. Players cannot, because a death opens the base.
As the jungler, stay alive for what spawns next. Their buff ends, and the next objective is where you get back in.
check: Which structures are left between them and your base, and who clears waves fastest.
breaks: If they also hold Baron and an inhibitor is open, there may be no time to wait. Fight at your towers with everyone alive.
